goal: Show durations under one minute as seconds only (30000 ms as "30s", not "0m 30s"); durations of one minute or more keep the current "<m>m <s>s" format.
required_behavior: formatDuration in src/duration.js stays exported as a function
a duration under one minute is formatted as whole seconds only, for example 30000 ms as "30s"
a duration of one minute or more keeps the current format, for example 90000 ms as "1m 30s"
constraints: Change only src/duration.js and files under test/
Do not change package.json, package-lock.json or .quarterback.json

requirements.quote: Show durations under one minute as seconds only, for example 30000 ms as "30s" instead of "0m 30s".
Durations of one minute or more keep the current format, for example 90000 ms stays "1m 30s".

acceptance_criteria.criterion: src/duration.js still exports formatDuration as a function
under one minute, seconds only: formatDuration(30000) returns "30s", formatDuration(1000) returns "1s" and formatDuration(0) returns "0s"
one minute or more keeps the current format: formatDuration(90000) returns "1m 30s", formatDuration(60000) returns "1m 0s" and formatDuration(3600000) returns "60m 0s"

verification_plan: module_exports: formatDuration from src/duration.js is a function
call_returns: formatDuration of 30000, 1000 and 0 ms returns "30s", "1s" and "0s"
call_returns: formatDuration of 90000, 60000 and 3600000 ms returns "1m 30s", "1m 0s" and "60m 0s"
